summary: The public title of this exercise is Combination Sum II. Read a count, that many integers, and one target integer from standard input and compute the result named by that title, using only those values. Print the result as a row count and then one line of integers per row. The sample below is a short input written for this playground so the printed line can be checked locally. It is not a copy of an example from the problem site. The input stays under one hundred elements so it finishes quickly in the browser.
notes: Compare after trimming trailing newlines. The input is a count, that many integers, and one target integer.
